top_signals.title: G7 nations to release diesel stocks as wars in Europe and Middle East constrain fuel supplies
top_signals.summary: EU countries are set for crisis talks on soaring diesel prices, with officials warning a U.S. export ban could hurt Europe’s economic outlook.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Dollar Falls as Soft Job Data Roils Timing of Fed Rate-Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: The dollar posted its worst day in a month on Friday after a report showed the US added fewer jobs than expected in September, briefly leading traders to waver on bets the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates again this year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Wall Street Tries to Live With 5% Yields as Market Cracks Grow
top_signals.summary: Wall Street has spent weeks trying to make peace with the great bond selloff. Friday offered some short-lived relief — along with a warning about the damage from stubbornly high yields across investment strategies of all stripes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
